mechanism: Pointformer Local Transformer uses sparse multi-head attention over PointNet++ local subsamples (sparsity 0.1 then 0.3 across two scales) so attention concentrates on mutually influential points in feature space rather than fixed spatial neighborhoods; without time coordinates, dense price-level clusters act as support/resistance density sensors, then Local-Global cross-attention and Global Transformer enrich scene context into a global point-cloud descriptor for the Actor encoder.
data_needed: Bar feature point cloud (BarDescr×HistoryBars); OpenCL sparse attention; Actor/Critic RL pipeline
why_new_for_mis: Treats S/R as unsupervised density in unordered feature space via sparse attention—MIS can expose attention-mass hotspots as liquidity/level sensors independent of calendar time.
quote: If we remove the coordinates (time), we are left with a point cloud in feature space. The regions where the price level occurs more frequently will naturally have a higher density of points... often such areas correspond to support and resistance levels.

mechanism: HyperDet3D MSA generates Q/K/V weights via element-wise product of scene-agnostic embeddings (static MLP from constant 1) and scene-specific embeddings (cross-attention of current scene vs learned Zs, tanh-scaled); detector parameters adapt per input scene so object-attribute ambiguity is resolved by scene prior—implemented by swapping Pointformer global attention for CNeuronMLMHSceneConditionAttention.
data_needed: Scene embedding from env encoder; scene-agnostic/specific hypernets; PointNet++ backbone candidates
why_new_for_mis: Explicit regime-conditioned parameter adaptation: MIS can treat scene-specific vs scene-invariant hypernet outputs as a live regime fingerprint that retunes downstream sensors.
quote: scene-conditioned knowledge can be decomposed into two levels: scene-invariant information and scene-specific information.

mechanism: SEFormer replaces isotropic Value transform with structure-dependent Wv keyed by relative position to learnable multi-scale centroids (2×center_points via MLP, cross-attended to local PointNet features); grid-interpolation idea becomes learned centroids in bar-feature space so local directional/distance structure is encoded into each bar embedding before scene-conditioned final attention and global PointNet descriptor.
data_needed: BarDescr×HistoryBars; center_points/center_window; CNeuronSEFormer; HyperDet3D scene attention reuse
why_new_for_mis: Direction-aware local structure sensor for price patterns that vanilla Transformers miss—MIS can read centroid–bar relative embeddings as a local-geometry regime feature.
quote: the same Value transformation is applied to all points in the Transformer, meaning it lacks the structural encoding capability inherent to convolution.

mechanism: SPFormer pools bar features into Superpoints via residual/conv downsampling, then a query decoder does Cross-Attention first (with predicted sigmoid masks thresholded at τ=0.5 to gate superpoint influence) then Self-Attention; each learnable query predicts class/confidence/mask for an instance without NMS—adapts 3D instance segmentation to market pattern instances.
data_needed: Point/bar feature tensor; K queries; OpenCL MHMaskAttentionOut; shared prediction head per decoder layer
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train 2023; test Jan 2024 (54 trades)
why_new_for_mis: Bottom-up Superpoint + top-down masked queries as a multi-pattern instance sensor—MIS can emit discrete pattern-instance masks/scores rather than a single scalar forecast.
quote: Based on the predicted superpoint masks Ml from the Mask branch, the superpoint attention masks Al are computed using a thresholding filter with τ=0.5

mechanism: MAFT drops hard mask-attention; computes continuous position bias kpb=1/exp(‖q−k‖) between positional queries and Superpoint PEs, adds it softly into cross-attention scores; Key gets PE while Value stays raw features; MLP predicts Δp to iteratively refine query centers—soft locality for price-movement instance sensing with faster convergence.
data_needed: Positional + content queries; Superpoint PE; CalcPositionBias + MHPosBiasAttentionOut kernels
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train 2023; test Jan 2024 (21 trades)
why_new_for_mis: Soft distance-gated attention is a robust locality sensor for MIS when hard masks from early training are unreliable—relative proximity becomes the gate.
quote: relative positional encoding provides greater flexibility and robustness to errors compared to masked attention. In essence, it functions as a soft mask that flexibly adjusts attention weights rather than applying rigid masking.

mechanism: 3D-GRES-style MDIN: encode account state/open positions as referring-expression tokens (MLP+PE) that cross-attend with dynamic queries generated from the input point cloud; DiversityLoss repels queries for scene coverage; null/multi-target outputs when confidence is low—guides the encoder to search for entry vs exit patterns conditioned on portfolio state.
data_needed: Account-state vector as SecondInput; Superpoints; DiversityLoss kernel; QSA/QLA decoder layers
why_new_for_mis: Portfolio-conditioned multimodal gate: MIS can treat account embedding as a referring query that selects which market patterns are currently actionable.
quote: instead of using a language model, we will encode account state and open positions as input to the model. Thus, depending on the embedding of the account state, the model will be guided to search for entry or exit points.

mechanism: PIRANHA EA: iBands(period=12, deviation=2) on close; buy when bar low crosses below lower band (oversold), sell when bar high crosses above upper band (overbought); one signal per bar, alternate direction; SL/TP in points—classic volatility-envelope extreme sensor.
data_needed: BB upper/lower buffers; bar high/low; Ask/Bid; sl_points/tp_points
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: _Symbol/_Period (Forex EA; Strategy Tester backtests with optimized SL/TP)
why_new_for_mis: Band-touch overbought/oversold flags are a direct vol-envelope extreme sensor MIS can fuse with neural regime sensors from the rest of this pack.
quote: If the price drops below the lower band, it is considered a great buying opportunity, while a rise above the upper band indicates that selling might be in order.

mechanism: RefMask3D CNeuronGEGWA: U-Net point encoder with recursive neck; each stage does self-attention+scale then multimodal cross-attention between local point groups and content (account-state) tokens, plus learnable background tokens so unmatched points attend to background instead of irrelevant words—early fusion of geometric local structure with referring context.
data_needed: Point cloud + content token tensor; CNeuronGEGWA; AddNeckGradient for decoder skip grads
why_new_for_mis: Group-word cross-modal attention with background sink is a noise-robust multimodal sensor—MIS can fuse price geometry with account/context tokens without spurious point–word ties.
quote: This integration not only reduces the noise typically associated with direct point-word correlations which is caused by the sparse and irregular nature of point clouds, but also exploits intrinsic geometric relationships

mechanism: Completes RefMask3D: LPC holds learnable primitives (shape/size/location-like attributes) cross-attending content; decoder of OCM layers matches U-Net neck skips; final OCM clusters primitives with context; three trainable background tokens concatenated with account-state embeddings filter noise; DiversityLoss on context∪background—outputs pattern-presence embeddings for Actor rather than pixel masks.
data_needed: CNeuronLPC, CNeuronOCM, CNeuronRefMask; account-state content_size; primitive_units; EURUSD H1 bars
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train 2023; test Jan 2024 (21 trades, ~66% win)
why_new_for_mis: Semantic-primitive + object-cluster pipeline yields a controlled pattern-presence regime vector gated by account context—MIS sensing of which described setups currently exist in the cloud.
quote: To make a decision about making a trading operation, it is enough to know about the presence of the desired patterns and their parameters.

mechanism: R-MAT Relative Self-Attention builds distance matrix as X·X^T (dot product encodes magnitude×cosθ so same-direction moves reinforce, opposite cancel); MLPs map it to BK/BV biases plus learnable global content/positional bias vectors; attention scores mix QK, Q·BK, K·BK, gc·K, gp·BK then Softmax; MH attention pooling aggregates heads—direction-aware temporal/relational encoding for bar sequences.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train 2023; test Jan 2024 (15 trades, ~60% win)
why_new_for_mis: Explicit direction-sensitive relative encoding (not absolute PE)—MIS can use the distance/bias maps as a trend-coherence sensor across the lookback window.
quote: In addition to distance, direction is also crucial. It is only unidirectional price movements that form trends and evolve into market tendencies.

mechanism: Molformer adaptation: CNeuronMotifs extracts overlapping pattern embeddings via conv and concatenates with raw bars into a heterogeneous atom+motif sequence; CNeuronMultiScaleAttention runs Relative Self-Attention at 1×/2×/3×/4× element widths (higher-timeframe analogy) then MH attention pooling blends scales—market-pattern motifs as first-class nodes for trend sensing.
data_needed: Bar sequence; motif window/step; 4-scale relative attention + pooling
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train 2023; test Jan 2024 (25 trades, 68% win)
why_new_for_mis: Elevates recurring candlestick motifs to graph nodes with multi-scale attention—MIS gets an explicit pattern-layer sensor alongside bar-level features.
quote: frequently occurring market patterns can be leveraged to more precisely identify interconnections and forecast trends.

mechanism: AMCT: parallel R-MAT pathways for bars (atoms) and motifs (CNeuronMotifEncoder with 2–3 then 3–5 bar overlapping patterns); OpenCL CalcAlignmentGradient applies KL-style alignment loss so atom and motif views of the same window mutually supervise; motif contrastive loss would align identical motifs across episodes; property cross-attention (started) weights which motifs drive the prediction—series incomplete (no finished live test in this article).
data_needed: Dual pathway outputs; CalcAlignmentGradient; motif encoder; property embeddings (next article)
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 context from series training stack; no completed Jan-2024 test in this part
why_new_for_mis: Self-supervised dual-view consistency between candle and pattern representations is a novel MIS authenticity/coherence sensor for pattern claims.
quote: Since atom and motif representations of a molecule are essentially two different views of the same entity, they naturally align during training.
